name: SMultisig
shortDescription: Non-custodial K-of-N threshold multisig for Safrochain teams — queue, sign, simulate, and execute treasury transactions.
description:
SMultisig is a non-custodial threshold multisignature wallet for teams, DAOs, and treasuries on Safrochain. Configure any K-of-N quorum with Cosmos SDK LegacyAmino multisig, compatible with Keplr, Leap, and Cosmostation.

Draft transactions off-chain with titles, memos, and fees; each signer approves the same SignDoc in their wallet. Simulate before broadcast, collect partial signatures, and submit when the threshold is met. The app coordinates drafts, roles, and metadata in a private collaboration layer — wallets hold the only private keys.

Supports native SAF, IBC tokens, and Token Factory denoms with auto-resolved symbols and icons. Sign in with ADR-036 wallet auth, role-based access for managers/signers/viewers, SignDoc verification, and encrypted multisig backups for recovery.
statusNote: Available on Safrochain testnet and mainnet (https://smultisig.safrochain.com).
